rationale: Reuses the existing max-scan loop in get_next_issue_number(); has no staleness gap unlike a git-ref-based read, which can't see uncommitted/unfetched issue files on main.
rule: Option A: filesystem union scan of the main working tree's .issues/ (extend get_next_issue_number's dirs_to_scan with the main-tree root, take max)
alternatives_rejected: Option B (git ls-tree <default-branch> ref scan): higher reuse score but has a real staleness gap for the exact collision this bug documents. Option C (min. viable guard via --git-common-dir): comparable new-code size to Option A, unhandled bare-repo edge case, no reusable guard-clause precedent, slower test fixture.
